description: This file defines the interface and factory for the IMediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService in the Rialto media server IPC component. It includes class declarations, method signatures for client connection management, and factory creation methods.

classes.name: IMediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IMediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService.

classes.name: IMediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService
classes.description: Interface for the MediaKeysCapabilitiesModule service, managing client connections.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new IMediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleServiceFactory instance.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IMediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService, given a reference to an ICdmService.

methods.name: clientConnected
methods.description: Handles a new client connection to the IPC service.

methods.name: clientDisconnected
methods.description: Handles disconnection of a client from the IPC service.
